dirichlet_multinomial_arm.reason: the dispersion audit measured a median variance ratio of 1.193 at the CORRECT share against a threshold of 1.25 fixed in code before the number was read. This system does not exhibit the overdispersion a Dirichlet-multinomial exists to model.

q9_is_frozen: the hurdle allocator, the one-target floor and both fallbacks are imported from nfl.research.q9.hurdle and called, never reimplemented or refitted here

falsifiable_check.reads: the fraction of the baseline's zero-mass shortfall each arm closes. The identifiability audit predicted a plain better-share arm could close about a third; an arm that closes all of it would mean the hurdle is a reparameterisation

selection_distortion.note: inside an affected draw the clearer set is already conditioned on clearing, so a selection rate below 1 is the subsample doing its job. What would be a defect is the rate depending on the DECLARED probability in a way the weighting did not intend -- the weighting is by the base share, not by p_hurdle, so a strong gradient here is the distortion to look for.

pit_diagnosis.note: PIT is diagnosed here and read by no decision. An arm selected on its rank histogram would be an arm selected on something that is not a proper score.
